meta.title: sokonanoda language service (DSH)
meta.description: One plugin: quiz turns are answered by the local course engine inside llm/stream (no model switch, no extra process); learn-card / Lean fences render as cards and highlighted code in the client, display-only, with typing as the interaction. Config, quiz progress and history live in ~/.dsh/state/sokonanoda-dsh/, never in the repository.
